      CEntity::PacketAround(&this->super_CEntity,&pack,0x11,(LPENTITY)0x0);
    }
    else {
      DESC::Packet(this_00,&pack,0x11);
    }
  }
switchD_0812e36f_caseD_0:
  return;
}
